Three independent reviews (engineering, codebase, product) were applied before code.

nodes.label: Photo time stamping «⏱ شبكة» / «⏱ جهاز»

nodes.label: PDF delivery src/doc/deliver.ts (deliverPdf, shareSummary)
nodes.rationale: Plugins destructured from awaited modules, every call under withTimeout; 'Share canceled' resolves cancelled with no toast.

nodes.label: Engine contract (Conf, Check, TraceStep, <PREFIX>_ENGINE)

nodes.norm_label: zoom lock (v0.1.8: viewport meta, touch-action, gesture listeners, native views)

nodes.rationale: auth (db.user(jwt)) → shape / size validation (per-feature LIMITS) → key present → salary aggregates as the member → ai_take → Gemini → SSE → ai_refund if the model failed before the first word → ai_tokens.

nodes.label: AI salary insights (salary_explorer fetched as the member, marketOnly)
nodes.norm_label: ai salary insights (salary_explorer fetched as the member, marketonly)
nodes.rationale: Give-to-get and the 5-report floor apply; only percentiles, n and track / governorate rows of 5+ survive, company rows are dropped; the member's own net salary travels only when they tick «قارن براتبي»; supervisors are refused; 24 h cache per cell.

nodes.rationale: Changing a prompt or schema is a function deploy, not an app update; PROMPT_VERSION is bumped with every change.

nodes.norm_label: «المهندس الذكي» smart engineer (gemini flash behind ai-chat)
nodes.rationale: A web-only change on native line 2, shipped as an OTA bundle; the app calls ask() / askJson() with the member JWT, never a key.

nodes.label: SSE protocol to the app (d / end / err events)
nodes.norm_label: sse protocol to the app (d / end / err events)
nodes.rationale: {t:d,x} deltas and {t:end,remaining}; errors arrive mid-stream as {t:err,code,ar,en} or as JSON with a status; the model's thought parts are never forwarded.

nodes.label: Supervisors never get pay talk (server-set noMoney)
nodes.norm_label: supervisors never get pay talk (server-set nomoney)
nodes.rationale: ai_take returns money:false for a supervisor and the proxy sets context.noMoney itself — the app's flag is never trusted.

nodes.label: Absent push credentials = «not ready in this build»
nodes.norm_label: absent push credentials = «not ready in this build»
nodes.rationale: Until Firebase / APNs credentials exist the app still works fully and the phone-side registration says not ready, never an error screen.

nodes.label: app-updates Storage bucket (<channel>/<version>.zip + manifest.json)
nodes.rationale: Public bucket; a bundle is ~10 MB (OCR data dominates) against a 50 MB limit; old bundles stay.

nodes.label: Settings → التحديثات الفورية (active bundle, status, manual check)
nodes.norm_label: settings → التحديثات الفورية (active bundle, status, manual check)
nodes.rationale: Shows built-in vs downloaded bundle, download %, rollbacks and «shell <version> · updater linked|missing».

nodes.label: Bundle integrity (SHA-256 verified download)
nodes.rationale: The plugin refuses a hash mismatch and the publish script re-checks that the public URL serves exactly the hashed bytes; manifest signing is not enabled — HTTPS + our bucket + the hash are the chain for now.

nodes.label: Live web updates (OTA web-bundle swap, v0.1.11)
nodes.norm_label: live web updates (ota web-bundle swap, v0.1.11)
nodes.rationale: Frontend, styling and logic changes reach the phones at the next launch without a new APK / IPA; nothing goes to Capgo (manual mode, empty updateUrl / statsUrl / channelUrl).

nodes.label: New shell wins (native build number raised on every release)
nodes.norm_label: new shell wins (native build number raised on every release)
nodes.rationale: The plugin drops a downloaded bundle when a newer shell is installed over it, so a fresh APK is never stuck on an old bundle.

nodes.label: Never await a Capacitor plugin object (Proxy then pitfall, v0.1.13)
nodes.norm_label: never await a capacitor plugin object (proxy then pitfall, v0.1.13)
nodes.rationale: A plugin Proxy answers then with a native wrapper, so a promise resolved with it never settles — the real cause of the endless spinner; promises carry the module and the plugin is read from it synchronously.

nodes.label: Publish web update (workflow + scripts/ota/publish.mjs)
nodes.rationale: check → build with the live keys → zip dist/ → upload to <channel>; SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN reads the service key at run time (masked); the workflow fails unless the manifest is public and CORS allows the WebView origins.

nodes.label: Unhealthy bundle rollback (notifyAppReady, engspace.ota.bad)
nodes.rationale: The app confirms a bundle only if the root rendered with no uncaught error and no error screen; otherwise the plugin reverts within 15 s and the failed version is never downloaded again.

nodes.label: Nothing waits forever — updater time limits (v0.1.12)
nodes.norm_label: nothing waits forever — updater time limits (v0.1.12)
nodes.rationale: The plugin's download() had no deadline and its worker retried forever; now manifest 10 s, plugin calls 6 s, download watchdog 30 s idle / 3 min, whole check 200 s; a running check is joined and a manual check always ends in a message.

nodes.label: Update check (4 s after launch, on resume ≤ every 30 min, or manual)
nodes.norm_label: update check (4 s after launch, on resume ≤ every 30 min, or manual)
nodes.rationale: Reads the manifest → parseManifest() → decide() → download() with the SHA-256 → next(); the banner offers «تحديث الآن» and ✕ applies it silently at the next cold start, so nobody has to open Settings. The flow diagram still says an 8 s manifest timeout while LIMITS.manifest and the v0.1.12 section say 10 s.

nodes.label: OTA install rules (well-formed manifest inside our bucket, newer build only)
nodes.norm_label: ota install rules (well-formed manifest inside our bucket, newer build only)
nodes.rationale: The manifest URL must be a .zip inside our app-updates bucket and manifest.build must exceed the running bundle's __BUILD__.ts.

nodes.label: Public verification: doc_receipts, QR and #app/v/<docId> (Phase 4b)
nodes.rationale: doc_receipts holds only {id, hash, issued_at} behind a rate-limited security-definer lookup; the signed-out page shows only number, revision, date and match / no match.

nodes.label: Tool store (src/lib/tool-store.ts: IndexedDB + member_state shards)
nodes.rationale: IndexedDB first; documents sync through member_state shards toolIndex + toolShelfA…L with per-document merge (conflict copy, tombstones); never rejects.

nodes.label: Tool hydrate (loadAll excludes tool%, stamps first, then changed shards)
nodes.norm_label: tool hydrate (loadall excludes tool%, stamps first, then changed shards)
nodes.rationale: Otherwise every hydrate would download all 24 shards (~21 MB) and stall the feed; tool loading runs in its own try/catch.

nodes.label: Native line (ota.config.json → nativeLine)
nodes.rationale: A bundle installs only if its nativeLine equals the shell's (versionName <nativeLine>.<build>); bump it for any change that needs a new shell, and older shells then ignore new bundles. Line 1 = first shells (v0.1.11); line 2 = v0.27.0 camera work.

nodes.label: Native photo flow (chooser → camera.ts permission check → compress → upload-media)
nodes.norm_label: native photo flow (chooser → camera.ts permission check → compress → upload-media)
nodes.rationale: v0.26.0 crashed because iOS ends an app that asks for the camera without NSCameraUsageDescription and an Android web view process death took the whole app; now permission is checked / requested before getPhoto, the plugin scales to ≤ 1600 px, and any plugin failure falls back to the plain input (capture=environment).

nodes.label: Native camera permissions (Info.plist privacy texts, Android CAMERA + <queries>)
nodes.norm_label: native camera permissions (info.plist privacy texts, android camera + <queries>)
nodes.rationale: With CAMERA declared nothing may start the camera before it is granted; Android 11+ hides the camera app without <queries> for IMAGE_CAPTURE; FileProvider paths cover external files and the cache.

nodes.label: Memory-safe decode in compress.ts (header read + createImageBitmap resize)
nodes.norm_label: memory-safe decode in compress.ts (header read + createimagebitmap resize)
nodes.rationale: Releases the decoded source before the encode loop, so a 50 MP photo no longer sits in the page process at full size.

nodes.label: private.photo_guard — profile photo must be the member's own avatar upload
nodes.norm_label: private.photo_guard — profile photo must be the member's own avatar upload

nodes.label: Write rate limits (private.limit_writes, SQLSTATE 54000)
nodes.rationale: Per-bucket burst / window / daily limits on posts, comments, messages, reviews, jobs, tickets and reports; staff and the service role are exempt; a SQL session may switch them off for tests, the Data API cannot.

nodes.label: mammoth 1.8 → 1.13 upgrade (GHSA-rmjr-87wv-gf87)
nodes.rationale: Fixes external file access from a crafted .docx.

nodes.label: Runtime dependencies moved from CDNs into the bundle
nodes.norm_label: runtime dependencies moved from cdns into the bundle
nodes.rationale: React, Tailwind, lucide, fonts, pdf.js, mammoth and Tesseract now ship with the app, so the built app makes no request outside its own origin.

nodes.label: Privacy rules the code keeps (document retention, on-device OCR, same-origin only)
nodes.norm_label: privacy rules the code keeps (document retention, on-device ocr, same-origin only)
nodes.rationale: Verification documents are held only until decided and 7 days at most; OCR runs on the device and nothing is uploaded; the built app loads nothing from outside its own origin (no CDN, no web fonts).

nodes.label: Tailwind independent of the working directory (content.relative)
nodes.norm_label: tailwind independent of the working directory (content.relative)
nodes.rationale: Tailwind 3 resolved its globs from the cwd, so a dev server started elsewhere produced almost no classes; now the CSS is byte-for-byte the same wherever the build starts.

nodes.label: E+S brand mark (src/ui/brand-mark.json) and icon generation
nodes.norm_label: e+s brand mark (src/ui/brand-mark.json) and icon generation
nodes.rationale: Polygons live in the 1024 space of the owner's master icon assets/icon-only.png — never redraw it; render.mjs, web.mjs and @capacitor/assets generate every size (delete the icons/ and manifest.webmanifest it also writes).

nodes.label: What OTA cannot do + store policy (Google Play, Apple 3.3.2 / 2.5.2)
nodes.norm_label: what ota cannot do + store policy (google play, apple 3.3.2 / 2.5.2)

nodes.label: Tools suite wave 1 (v0.28.0)
nodes.rationale: Stack types tool (#app/tool/<id>) and tooldoc (#app/tooldoc/<kind>:<docId|new>); a new document gets its id on the first edit via app.replaceTop; field tools have no price fields.

nodes.norm_label: tool registry tool_registry (pure data, no imports)
nodes.rationale: No imports so taxonomy can import it without a cycle and Playwright's loader can generate e2e tests from it; money: true never lists supervisor; aliases resolve old ids.

nodes.norm_label: ai_quota() — remaining units for the quota chip

nodes.norm_label: acinstall · فحص تركيب التكييف (ac installation check)

nodes.norm_label: phase 4: mep and electrical quick checks (acinstall, drainrun, sprinklercheck, cablecheck)

nodes.norm_label: iec60364-2009@1 (factor tables with a verified flag per table)

nodes.rationale: Principle 5: code profiles, never constants. Profile ids are immutable (a value change makes @n+1) and documents snapshot the constants they used, so a reprint years later prints the same figures after an OTA engine fix.

nodes.norm_label: document kit (src/doc: docspec → doclayout → raster pdf backend)
nodes.rationale: Pure mm layout with the issuer's title block, running header and paged tables; 240 dpi lossless 16-colour pages; renderDoc never rejects; canvas ignores LRI/PDI so lines without Arabic are drawn LTR; a plain letterhead mode serves the CV.

nodes.label: Document hash and fingerprint «بصمة المستند»
nodes.rationale: Wave 1 prints 16 hex instead of a QR that would only verify on the issuer's phone; crypto.subtle is undefined on plain HTTP (LAN phone preview), hence the sha256hex fallback.

nodes.norm_label: raster backend (240 dpi, lossless 4-bit indexed flate pages)
nodes.rationale: A greyscale-plus-accent theme makes 16 inks exact, so pages are lossless with no JPEG smudge; JPEG fallback if the worker fails; ≤ 300 KB per dense page and ≤ 1.2 s per page on Pixel 7 at 4x throttle.

nodes.label: Report typography: IBM Plex Sans Arabic subsets (450/600/700)
nodes.norm_label: report typography: ibm plex sans arabic subsets (450/600/700)
nodes.rationale: Arabic never below 9 pt in tables; Latin digits because Plex's Arabic-Indic digits are not tabular; subsets committed so the build never runs Python.

nodes.label: Gradual typing (gradual-types.cjs + type-fixes.cjs, strict off)
nodes.rationale: Explicit gradual types let tsc check every file without rewriting logic (0 errors with strict off); follow-up: strictNullChecks, then strict, module by module from domain/ and lib/.
